title: Baseball
text:
Baseball
This site explores the history of Major League Baseball through the Lahman database. Looking at home runs per team-game reveals a steadier story than raw totals alone: shortened seasons may look unusual at first, but their rates put them in the context of the broader history of the game.
We also identify baseball’s career home-run leaders and take a closer look at Barry Bonds’s season-by-season record. Visit the Home runs and Sluggers pages from the navbar to explore the analysis.
